selected_correction.scope: Both passive caster wheel joints only; swivel damping stays unchanged
selected_correction.evidence: Repeatable under-rotation and excessive configured drag in clear-floor x=1.0–1.8 m
selected_correction.qualification: Single physical-model candidate, not a validated cure for all impact spikes; real axle drag must be measured
selected_correction.validation_required: Repeat the existing four cold-start comparisons before any flat PPO pilot

limitations: IMU peaks are action-interval summaries, not individually timestamped raw IMU samples.
A contact/IMU temporal association does not establish causation.
Contact force values are solver outputs; sums times dt are diagnostic proxies, not calibrated impulses.
Joint velocities are simulation states; no real caster measurement is available.
Four episodes of one evaluation seed do not establish generalization.
